s: Kamma dine hatmana vetiltulam ubo ch' seipim: mokin shettaman bahem haqqedera mibbeod yom derek miqreh, shello yichadan lekak — asur letaltelam beshabbat, lepi shehem muqtzim, shemmin hassetam hem omedim laasot mehem lebadim velo lehatmin bahem qederot o shear tashmish hammuttar beshabbat, veen alehem torat keli kelal. Abal im yichadam lehatmana, dehaynu sheggamar bedato lehatmin bahem leolam — muttar letaltelam, dekevan shehem reuyim lehatmana vehu yichadam lekak — hare yesh alehem torat keli, meachar shehen reuyim lattashmish hammeyuchad lahem. Abal im taman begizze tzemer, ap al pi shello yichadan — lekak muttar letaltelan, sheen haggizzin chashubin kol kak, ukeshemmatmin bahem paam achat min hassetam omedot hen lehatmana. Abal haggizzin shennetanno laotzar lischora (vehu maqpid alehen lehishtammesh bahen shum tashmish ella) shettaman bahen derek miqreh — asur letaltelam beshabbat, ella im ken yichadam lekak leolam:

Keshettaman bedabar sheasur letaltelo uba littol mehem haqqedera beshabbat ketzad hu oseh? Im kissuy haqqedera megulleh miqtzato mehahatmana — ochez bemiqtzat hamgulleh umesiro. Veap shehahatmana hammuqtza munnachat alayv — eno naaseh basis ledabar haasur, lepi sheen hakkissuy meshammesh kelal lahatmana ella laqqedera. Veochez berashe dopne haqqedera shennitgallu mittachat hakkissuy umotzi et haqqedera kullah mehatmana. Veim en hakkissuy megulleh kelal, im yakol litchob kosh o sakkin betok hakkissuy ulehagbiho velahasiro mehaqqedera — hare zeh muttar. Veap shemmetaltel hahatmana al yede hakkissuy — en bekak kelum, shettiltul min hatztzad hu veeno tiltul, kemo sheyyitbaer besimman shy"a:

Bameh debarim amurim? Bekissuy qedera sheyyesh torat keli alayv veeno muqtzeh, abal im gam hakkissuy hu dabar hammuqtzeh, im miqtzat dopne haqqedera megullim kol kak mehatmanat hammuqtzeh ad sheyyakol leechoz sham beyadayv — hare zeh ochez sham umagbiah haqqedera umotziah mishsham, vehahatmana nopelet mealeha meeleha, veachar kak menaarah ad sheyyippol mealeha hakkissuy hammuqtzeh, shehaqqedera lo naaset basis lehakkissuy ulehahatmana, lepi shehakkissuy vehahatmana hem meshammeshim lehaqqedera lechammemah, veen haqqedera meshammeshet lahen:

Hattomen bequppa melea mokin sheasur letaltelam vehotzi mishsham haqqedera al derek shennitbaer, kol zeman shello nitqalqela hagguma — yakol lehachazirah lesham. Abal im nitqalqela hagguma — asur lehachazirah, lepi shemmetaltel hammokin hammuqtzin al yede hachazarat haqqedera. Veeno domeh letiltul hahatmana al yede hakkissuy, shehahatmana mittaltelet meeleha al yede hakkissuy, vehu eno mitkavven ella letiltul hakkissuy bilbad, ella shei epshar lo letaltel hakkissuy bilbaddo shello tehe hahatmana mittaltelet immo, abal kan hu metaltel hahatmana beyadayim al yede haqqedera, shetztzarik lesalleq hahatmana elak veelak kede leharchib hagguma meqom moshab haqqedera. Abal lekattechilla yakol lehotzi haqqedera al daat lehachazirah achar kak im lo titqalqel hagguma, veen chosheshin shemma yabo lehachazirah ap im titqalqel:

Hannotenim abanim ulebenim sebib hakkira — tzarik sheyyeyachadem lekak leolam kede sheyyehe muttar letaltelam beshabbat. Veken etzim haomedim lehassaqa shessotemim bahem pi hattannur beshabbat — tzarik sheyyeyachadem lekak leolam, shehare kol zeman shello yichadan lekak enan chashubim lo umashlikan, ulepikak asur letaltelam im lo shemmatznian umeyachadan lekak. Umikkol maqom, otan haabanim hammunnachim al gabbe hakkira — en tzarik yichud beperush, shemmin hassetam hem meyuchadim letashmish:

Yom tob shechal lihyot beereb shabbat — asur lehatmin chammin leshabbat baabanim, sheasur letzadded abanim beyom tob, mippene sheddomeh lebinyan. Umikkol maqom, im en lo bammeh lehatmin ki im baabanim — yesh lehattir lehatmin bahem, mippene sheen kan binyan qabua ella binyan aray, veeno asur ella middibre soperim, umishshum kebod shabbat lo gazeru, kevan shei epshar lo lehatmin beinyan acher:

Tannur shemmannichim bo hachammin leshabbat vesotemin piv bedap veshoreqim oto betit — muttar listor otah setima beshabbat kede lehotzi hachammin. Veap al pi shehattannur mechubbar laqqarqa veasur listor binyan hamchubbar laqqarqa, mikkol maqom hoil umin hattora en issur ella keshessoter gup habbinyan abal lo keshessoter pitcho, ella shechakamim hu sheggazeru shello listor delatot shel binyan hamchubbar laqqarqa, velo gazeru ella keshehaddelet naaseh sham leqiyyum leezeh zeman shello haya bedato al menat lesotro beshabbat vahare zeh nireh kesoter, abal sheriqat hattannur shello naaset kelal leqiyyum ella lishmor hachom lepi shaa ulesotrah lemachar — lo gazeru aleha. Veyesh machmirim shello yistor otah al yede yisrael im epshar al yede nokri. Veken im epshar al yede qatan — en lesotrah al yede gadol. Veim i epshar — yistor gadol al yede shinnuy qetzat. Veken nohagim. Umikkol maqom, im yadua sheyyesh battannur gechalim lochashot — asur lepotcho al yede yisrael, mippene sheharuach niknas bo umabir haggechalim, veap sheeno mitkavven lehabir, mikkol maqom "pesiq resheh velo yamut" hu. Abal al yede nokri muttar, shekkol "pesiq resheh" en bo issur amira lenokri, kemo shennitbaer besimman rn"g. Veken im rotzeh lachazor velistom hattannur bedap veyesh betoko gechalim lochashot — asur lesotmo al yede yisrael, mippene sheharuach mepiach derek sedeq qatan, vedomeh lemepiach umabir haggechalim yoter meillu haya hattannur patuach. Abal al yede nokri muttar. Veap leyisrael muttar lesotmo kol sheeno sotemo legamre, ubilbad sheyyanniach harbeh patuach, abal im manniach meat patuach — kol shekken sheharuach mepiach, veasur:

Apillu en bo gechalim (lochashot) — en hetter lachazor ulesotmo beshabbat ella im ken yadua beberur shekkebar nitbashshelu haqqederot kol tzorkan, abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma lo nitbashshelu adayin kol tzorkan, kegon ballayla samuk lehatmanatan — asur listom hattannur apillu al yede nokri, mippene sheggorem lemaher bishshulam. Vaapillu bediabad asur hattabshil. Umikkol maqom, im asa al yede nokri — yesh lehattir bediabad, meachar sheap im lo haya sotem (hattabshil) [hattannur] haya hattabshil gam ken mitbashshel kol tzorko, nimtza sheeno neheneh kol kak mehaissur. Ulekattechilla tob lizzaher shello lomar lenokri listom hattannur achar qabbalat shabbat, apillu qodem chasheka, im haqqederot lo nitbashshelu adayin kol tzorkan, veap al pi shemmin haddin muttar (ayyen leqamman). Hilkot shehiyya vehatmana biqtzara lepi minhag medinot ellu: kelal haddabar akshav sheanu mannichim haqqederot betok hattannur megullot, veen anu osim shum hatmana sebib dopnotehen veal pihen, im ken en lahem raq din shehiyya velo din hatmana, ulepikak im nitbashshelu kemaakal ben derusai mibbeod yom — muttar lehashhotan, ap al pi sheen hattannur garup velo qatum. Ubasar, im noteno chay baqqedera samuk lachasheka mammash — hare zeh muttar. Abal bemine batzeq, ben mebushshalim ben neepim, ubemine qitniyyot, ubemayim, ubetzali hannitzleh beshappud — en moil chay, vetzarik sheyyihyu kemaakal ben derusai qodem shabbat. Ubetannur tuach betit — hakkol muttar bekol inyan. Veim yesh bo gechalim lochashot — en lepotcho ki im al yede nokri. Veim haggechalim sebib haqqedera — lo yittol yisrael haqqedera mittoko ki im nokri. Veim haqqedera omedet al haggechalim — muttar im i epshar al yede nokri. (Vehu haddin biqderot shelletzorek hallayla, im heemidan al haggechalim uba littelan beshabbat meal haggechalim. Raq sheyyizzaher shello yekasseh otan bibgadim milmala keshemmaamidan al haggechalim, apillu hen omemot). Umuttar lismok tabshil cham shennitbashshel kol tzorko etzel hattannur shehussaq kebar vehaesh betoko, vaapillu al hallebizbaz shessebib hattannur. Abal al hattannur tzarik litten lebena o dabar acher tachat haqqedera al hattannur shehussaq kebar veyesh gechalim lochashot betoko, ap al pi sheen hayyad soledet sham alayv milmala, abal keshello hussaq adayin — nahagu lehaqel ap al pi sherotzeh lehassiqo miyyad. Abal tabshil tzonen, apillu qodem shehussaq — asur apillu lismok etzlo, ki im al yede nokri qodem shehussaq, veaz muttar apillu al gabbayv. Abal leachar shehussaq asur apillu al yede nokri, ki im letzorek choleh o qatan sheen lo mah leekol. Vetabshil sheen bo roteb, apillu hu qar — dino kecham. Veim adayin lo nitztannen legamre, ap al pi sheyyesh bo roteb — nahagu lehaqel keillu hu cham legamre. Veim somek etzel hattannur bemaqom sheen yakol lehitchammem ad shehayyad soledet bo — muttar apillu nitztannen legamre. Abal al hattannur tzarik dabar hammapsiq ap sheen hayyad soledet sham, veap im hattabshil cham legamre. Vehu haddin letok haqqekli"n tzarik dabar hammapsiq. Uperot chayyim, veken mine mashqin, dinam ketabshil sheyyesh bo roteb venitztannen legamre, ben leissur ben lehetter. Velitten al gabbe qedera haqqebua battannur dinah keetzel hattannur. Abal asur litten qanqan im mashqin letok hammayim shebbaqqedera hahi. Veasur litten hammayim laqqedera hahi apillu qodem shehussaq hattannur ki im al yede nokri. Umuttar lehanot mehammayim beshabbat im netanam nokri qodem shehussaq hattannur. Abal im netanam yisrael asur lehanot mehem ad motzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu. Vaapillu netanam beereb shabbat samuk lachasheka achar shehussaq hattannur — asur lehanot mehem ad lemotzae shabbat bikde sheyyeasu. Veasur likrok beshabbat qedera im tabshil (cham) bekarim ukesatot o bishar begadim im kullah temuna bahem. Veim pinna hattabshil liqdera acheret — muttar lekorko sham: seliq qitztzur hilkot shehiyya vehatmana
